summary: Round 7 — Verified that the api.ts change (detect non-JSON/HTML response and throw a clean message instead of dumping raw HTML) did NOT regress normal JSON API flows. Backend pytest: 63/65 PASS on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://clanchat-mobile-1.preview.emergentagent.com. The 20 tests in backend_test.py (register, login-ok/401, /me, public-key update, pair create/redeem/get, messages send+list+after-filter, worries, events) all PASS — confirming normal JSON parse path in api.ts still works. test_round2 (24 tests: media roundtrip, view-once 410, checkins gating), test_round3_gallery (all gallery + regression tests) PASS. Only 2 failures: test_round4 TestLiveKitToken (503 'Calling is not configured') — pre-existing, unrelated to this change. Direct curl regression: POST /api/auth/login with real creds -> 200 + JSON access_token; wrong pw -> 401 {"detail":"Incorrect email or password"}; Content-Type: application/json. Frontend UI (Expo web @ 375x667): (1) wrong-pw path — api.ts now reads res.text() then JSON.parse'd it correctly, login-error shows 'Incorrect email or password' (no raw HTML, no crash). (2) Correct-pw path — token JSON parsed, navigated /login -> /pair, 'Hi Tam 👋' visible (JSON success path intact). (3) Server settings panel — login-server-toggle reveals login-server-input prefilled with current host, login-server-save persists normalized value ('Server set to https://clanchat-mobile-1.preview.emergentagent.com', trailing slash stripped). No react-native red screen; only pre-existing warnings ('shadow* deprecated', 'expo-notifications web'). The api.ts change is safe: the looksHtml gate only fires when text.trim().startsWith('<'), and every backend response from this preview (both 2xx and 4xx) is application/json starting with '{', so the JSON.parse branch is always taken for real API traffic. The HTML branch is only reachable when a proxy/region-gate returns an HTML error page — that scenario cannot be reproduced from this test env (owner region), but the code path is straightforward and reviewed.

minor.issue: Returns 503 'Calling is not configured' — LiveKit env vars not set in this preview. Pre-existing, unrelated to api.ts change. Only affects the calling feature.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/lib/api.ts: looksHtml = text.trim().startsWith('<') is a safe, cheap heuristic. It cannot false-positive on legitimate JSON API responses (JSON always starts with '{', '[', '"', digit, 'true', 'false', 'null'). Verified live: both 200 JSON and 401 JSON responses take the JSON.parse branch and set error.message = data.detail correctly.

api.ts change consumes res.text() once then optionally JSON.parses it — this is fine (fetch body can only be consumed once, but the previous implementation also did res.json() which internally does the same). No double-read bug.

Region-restricted branch uses /region restricted/i regex, matching Emergent's 'Region Restricted - Emergent' banner. Generic HTML fallback message is user-actionable ('Check the Server address in login → Server settings.'). Good UX pairing with the existing login-server-toggle panel.
Minor: the HTML branch will not run for a 401 that happens to return HTML (e.g. some CDN 401 pages) — but message includes a Server-settings hint, so still actionable. No change needed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (wrong-pw JSON error, correct-pw success -> /pair, server-settings toggle+save+normalize)

seed_data_creation: Used the real owner account (thomasgallacher92@gmail.com / Ladyinred_1). Pytest fixtures create ephemeral TEST_*@twogether-test.com accounts. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The api.ts non-JSON/HTML guard is verified safe: normal JSON responses (200 and 4xx) parse correctly, wrong-pw shows clean 'Incorrect email or password', correct-pw navigates to /pair. The HTML→clean-error branch cannot be reproduced from this test env because the preview backend is not region-blocked here — code path is a simple text-startsWith('<') check followed by throw new Error(...), which E1 can trust. Do not modify api.ts / config.ts / login.tsx.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: a partner in another region saw the raw HTML 'Region Restricted - Emergent' page inside the login-error <Text> because api.ts previously called res.json() which threw a generic SyntaxError, and the fallback dumped the raw response body. Fix (already applied by E1): switch to res.text() first, detect leading '<' (HTML), throw a user-friendly Error whose .message is caught by login.tsx submit() and rendered in the login-error component. Verified: (a) the JSON branch is unchanged for real API traffic — both success (200) and auth-error (401) still surface exactly as before; (b) if the branch ever fires, the user gets an actionable message plus the existing on-device Server-settings override to point at a non-region-gated URL.
